label: IFRS/GAAP Implementation Advisor
description: Provides guidance on implementing new IFRS or GAAP standards. Analyzes standard requirements, assesses accounting policy choices, and structures implementation project plan.

claudeKnowledge.description: IFRS standards (IASB), US GAAP (FASB), Swedish K3, EFRAG endorsement status, Big Four implementation guidance

guidedInputs.label: Standard details or custom standard
guidedInputs.placeholder: If 'Other' above, describe the standard. Or provide additional context about scope, amendments, or transition options being considered.

guidedInputs.label: Entity profile
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the entity: industry, size, key business activities, current accounting policies relevant to this standard, and existing systems.
e.g. Swedish insurance group, 3 500 MSEK premium revenue, currently applying old IAS 39 for financial instruments, Oracle ERP.

guidedInputs.label: Effective date / first reporting period
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Financial year ending 31 December 2025 (mandatory for listed entities)

guidedInputs.label: Current accounting policies (affected areas)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe existing accounting policies in the areas affected by the standard. These will be compared against the new requirements to identify gaps.

guidedInputs.label: Known complexities or areas of concern
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Complex lease portfolio with variable lease terms, historical data availability for ECL model (IFRS 9), disclosure requirements exceed current data capture.
